headline: 10 Seconds
caption:
Merab Dvalishvili admits he knew the Petr Yan rematch was lost after one stuffed takedown.
Merab or Yan? 👇

Merab says that round-two stop drained his energy in seconds, so he just tried to enjoy the fight. Yan defends the UFC bantamweight title against him in the trilogy at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi on Oct 24.

Who takes the trilogy?
question: Merab or Yan?

v2.story: Merab says one stuffed takedown in round two told him the Yan rematch was gone.
v2.question: Merab or Yan?
